s.how: Serve 200g crackers with 200g cheese spread. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table. Put it out before the opening credits so everyone can graze.
Simmer 24 cocktail franks in water for 5 minutes and drain. Serve on toothpicks with mustard and tomato sauce for dipping. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

m.how: Mix 800g beef mince, onion, egg and breadcrumbs, bake at 180C for 1 hour and serve with mash and gravy. Bring it to the middle of the table so everyone helps themselves.

w.how: Bake a chocolate cake from 300g self-raising flour, 300g sugar, 60g cocoa, 2 eggs, 250ml milk and 125g butter at 175C for 40 minutes. Ice and serve.

d.how: Brew 60g ground coffee in 1L water and serve black. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold. Keep a second round ready for the back half of the film.
